end.name_zh: 宜兴市高塍镇徐家桥村
end.geocode_source: Nominatim has no separate feature for Xujiaqiao village; coordinates are the host town centroid via query 'Gaocheng,Yixing,Wuxi,Jiangsu' -> osm relation 17003808. Village-level precision is in the source text, not the geocode.

corridor_notes: Wuxi Municipal Bureau of Natural Resources land-use approval notice (2017-09-18, referencing provincial approval 苏政地[2017]421号) for '川气东送管道金武管道—国信宜兴燃机热电联产天然气支线工程' (Sichuan-East pipeline, Jinwu Pipeline to Guoxin Yixing gas turbine CHP natural gas branch) confirms the branch terminates at the Guoxin Yixing plant site in '高塍镇徐家桥村' (Xujiaqiao Village, Gaocheng Town, Yixing) -- '高塍镇徐家桥村农用地0.8389公顷...转为建设用地'. This is the same Gaocheng Town host as P7432's Yixing-branch endpoint, consistent with Gaocheng being a hub area for Sichuan-East-sourced gas supply in eastern Yixing. Note: a separate, unrelated EIA (jshbgz.cn PDF, '江苏国信宜兴燃机热电联产工程专用输气管道项目') describes the SAME Guoxin Yixing plant receiving a different supply line from '西气东输宜兴分输站' (the West-East [Xinjiang-sourced] pipeline's own Yixing distribution station, near Dingshu Town) -- that is NOT this PID's line and was not used here, but explains why searches surface two distinct 'Guoxin Yixing gas line' EIAs (dual-sourced plant).
researcher_notes: END point is solid (government land-approval document, village-level, exact plant-site match). START point ('Jinwu Pipeline' per GEM) could not be pinned to a named tie-in station: a related but distinct EIA (czcdhb.com PDF, downloaded and pdftotext'd) describes a 'Jinwu line receiving gate station' (金武线接收门站) at Anwei Village, Xueyan Town, Wujin District, Changzhou (常州市武进区雪堰镇安圩村) -- but that document is explicitly a *downstream, Wujin-district* distribution project (medium-pressure mains to Wujin roads), not the Guoxin Yixing branch, so its station is very unlikely to be this PID's actual start (Xueyan/Wujin to Xujiaqiao/Yixing is a much longer distance than a 13km branch would cover). The taohuren.com source used for P7432 separately mentions a 'Jinwu pipeline phase 2' passing through Heqiao and Wanshi towns in Yixing (~33km) -- those Yixing towns are geographically much closer to Gaocheng/Xujiaqiao and are a more plausible source-side context for a short 13km branch, but no source directly ties a named station in Heqiao/Wanshi to this specific Guoxin branch. Left start uncoded rather than guessing.
blockers: Start/tie-in station for the 'Jinwu Pipeline' side not found in any accessible source. The bidcenter.com.cn EIA report that most directly matches this PID's exact project name ('金武管道—国信宜兴燃气热电联产天然气支线工程环境影响报告') was blocked by a human-verification wall on both direct fetch and the r.jina.ai reader proxy; a human researcher with a browser could likely retrieve it. WebSearch tool budget exhausted mid-session; remaining searches used DuckDuckGo/Sogou via WebFetch.
